indication: Previously treated advanced RAS-mutated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
population_detail: RMC-6236-001 (NCT05379985) phase 1/2 PDAC cohort; 168 PDAC patients dosed at 300 mg or lower; second-line RAS G12 subgroup analyzed at the 300-mg dose (n=26). G12X variants enrolled include G12D, G12V, G12R, and Q61H — the patient's G12R is in scope.
design: Open-label multicenter phase 1/2 dose-escalation and dose-expansion
outcome: ORR (RECIST 1.1), median PFS, median OS, median DoR in 2L RAS G12 PDAC at 300 mg
median_dor_or_pfs: mDoR 8.2 mo; mPFS 8.5 mo; mOS 13.1 mo (n=26, 2L RAS G12, 300 mg)
safety_summary: Treatment-related AEs of any grade in 96% of the 168-patient PDAC cohort and grade 3 or higher in 30%; characteristic events are an EGFR-like rash, GI toxicity (diarrhea, nausea, stomatitis), and fatigue.

toxicities.notes: Pooled across the 160-300 mg PDAC cohort.
Pooled across the 160-300 mg PDAC cohort.
Earlier July 2024 cutoff (n=127) reported any-grade rash at 91% — characteristic class effect for pan-RAS inhibition.

notes: Pivotal NEJM publication of the RMC-6236-001 PDAC cohort. The ORR 35% / mPFS 8.5 / mOS 13.1 in 2L RAS G12 at 300 mg is the load-bearing efficacy anchor for this case — G12R sits inside the G12 pooled cohort. G12R-specific subgroup ORR was not separately published; the field reads G12X as a single estimand pending phase 3 readout. Allele-resolved breakdown is the open question.

intervention_dose: Amph-Peptides (G12D + G12R) with Amph-CpG-7909 10.0 mg SC prime/boost per protocol
indication: Resected PDAC and CRC with ctDNA / tumor-marker MRD positivity after locoregional therapy (AMPLIFY-201)
population_detail: MRD-positive after curative-intent surgery and standard adjuvant therapy; 25 patients (20 PDAC, 5 CRC); KRAS G12D or G12R required. The patient's G12R is in scope, but the patient is overt-recurrent rather than MRD-only.
outcome: Safety, immunogenicity (T-cell response), tumor-biomarker response, relapse-free survival
median_dor_or_pfs: mRFS 16.33 mo overall; NR vs 4.01 mo when stratified by above-median T-cell expansion
safety_summary: No dose-limiting toxicities through the dose-escalation; phase 2 dose set at 10.0 mg Amph-CpG-7909; no grade 3+ vaccine-attributed events reported in the primary report.

toxicities.notes: No DLTs observed at the RP2D.
Most common AE class per the report; full grade breakdown not in the abstract.

notes: G12R explicitly in the 2-peptide panel. Cohort is MRD-positive resected disease, not overt-recurrent — case fit is partial. Predecessor to ELI-002 7P (NCT05726864).

intervention_label: ELI-002 2P (amphiphile mKRAS peptide vaccine) — final AMPLIFY-201 report
intervention_dose: Amph-Peptides (G12D + G12R) with Amph-CpG-7909 SC per protocol
indication: Resected PDAC and CRC with MRD positivity post locoregional therapy (AMPLIFY-201 final follow-up)
population_detail: Final report at 19.7 months median follow-up; n=25 (20 PDAC, 5 CRC); KRAS G12D / G12R targeted.
outcome: Final RFS, OS, sustained T-cell responses
median_dor_or_pfs: mRFS not reached in high-responders vs 3.02 mo in low-responders; mOS not reached vs 15.98 mo
safety_summary: Maintained tolerability at extended follow-up; 71% of evaluable patients induced both CD4 and CD8 KRAS-specific T-cell responses.
notes: Final 2025 readout. Strengthens the vaccine class signal in MRD-positive resected disease and supports the ongoing 7-peptide successor (ELI-002 7P, NCT05726864). Overt recurrence sits outside the trial's enrollment window for this case.

indication: Pretreated advanced KRAS p.G12C-mutated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (CodeBreaK 100 PDAC cohort)
population_detail: 38 patients with KRAS G12C-mutated PDAC; median 2 prior lines (range 1-8). G12C is a different allele from the patient's G12R — sotorasib does not bind G12R.
design: Phase 1/2 single-arm pooled (phase 1 n=12 + phase 2 n=26)
safety_summary: Treatment-related AEs in 42% any grade and 16% grade 3; no grade 4-5 treatment-related events and no discontinuations for toxicity.

toxicities.notes: Diarrhea and fatigue were the two most common any-grade events.

notes: Mechanism-class context only — sotorasib is G12C-selective and does not act on KRAS G12R. The 21% ORR establishes proof-of-concept that allele-selective covalent KRAS blockade works in PDAC, which is what anchors the pan-RAS / pan-G12X rationale for a G12R patient. Tag: case_match cross_tumor_only flags the mutation-class mismatch even though the indication matches.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS G12C mutation, excluding NSCLC and CRC (KRYSTAL-1 cohort)
population_detail: 63 treated patients; pancreatic n=21, biliary tract n=12, other GI / gyne. G12C-only — not relevant to the patient's G12R at the molecular level.
safety_summary: Treatment-related AEs in 96.8% any grade and 27% grade 3-4 with no grade 5 events; characteristic events are nausea, diarrhea, fatigue, and vomiting.
notes: PDAC subset ORR 33.3% (7/21) and biliary 41.7% (5/12) — consistent with sotorasib in the same indication. G12C-selective; off-axis for a G12R patient. Logged for the allele-selective-KRAS class precedent that the pan-RAS programs are extending to non-G12C alleles.

indication: Germline BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic PDAC, maintenance after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy (POLO)
population_detail: 154 randomized; gBRCA1/2 pathogenic variant; no progression after ≥16 weeks of first-line platinum. The patient has no germline data yet and was treated with adjuvant FOLFIRI (no platinum exposure), so both biomarker and platinum-exposure gates are open.
median_dor_or_pfs: mPFS 7.4 mo olaparib vs 3.8 mo placebo; interim mOS 18.9 vs 18.1 mo (HR 0.91, NS)
safety_summary: Grade 3+ AEs in 40% of olaparib patients vs 23% of placebo; treatment discontinuation for AEs 5% vs 2%. No new safety signals.
notes: Pivotal RCT driving FDA approval of olaparib maintenance in gBRCA-mutant metastatic PDAC. The case requires both germline testing (currently outstanding) and platinum induction (currently not on file) to unlock this pathway.

indication: Platinum-sensitive advanced PDAC with germline or somatic BRCA1/2 or PALB2 pathogenic variant
population_detail: 46 enrolled, 42 evaluable; germline BRCA1 n=7, BRCA2 n=27, PALB2 n=6; somatic BRCA2 n=2. Broader than POLO by including PALB2 and somatic variants.
median_dor_or_pfs: mPFS 13.1 mo; mOS 23.5 mo; ORR 41.7% (15/36 with measurable disease); mDoR 17.3 mo
safety_summary: No new safety signals during maintenance; PARP inhibitor class effects (fatigue, anemia, nausea) at expected rates.
notes: Extends the PARP signal beyond gBRCA to include sBRCA and PALB2 — relevant for the case only if germline / somatic HRD testing returns positive. Currently not on file; gated by the germline panel in target_validation.jsonl.

intervention_dose: avutometinib 3.2 mg PO twice weekly + defactinib 200 mg PO BID, 3-weeks-on / 1-week-off
indication: Recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer (LGSOC), KRAS-mutant and wild-type (RAMP 201)
population_detail: Recurrent LGSOC after ≥1 prior systemic therapy; KRAS-mutant ORR pulled separately. Cross-tumor: not PDAC but the load-bearing efficacy precedent for the RAF/MEK + FAK clamp combo in a KRAS-mutant disease.
outcome: Confirmed ORR by BICR; mPFS; mDoR; subset analyses by KRAS status
median_dor_or_pfs: mDoR 31.1 mo overall (KRAS-mut 31.1 mo, KRAS-wt 9.2 mo); mPFS 12.9 mo overall (KRAS-mut 22 mo, KRAS-wt 12.8 mo)
safety_summary: Manageable AE profile; most patients continued therapy. Class effects include rash, edema, CK elevation, and reversible ocular events.
notes: FDA accelerated approval for KRAS-mutant recurrent LGSOC based on this readout. Cross-tumor precedent for the avutometinib+defactinib backbone that RAMP-205 (NCT05669482) is testing in 1L PDAC.

intervention_dose: avutometinib 3.2 mg PO twice weekly + defactinib 200 mg PO BID + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel per protocol
indication: Treatment-naive metastatic PDAC, KRAS-mutant or wild-type (RAMP 205)
population_detail: Phase 1b/2; 41 patients dosed across 4 dose levels as of May 2024; KRAS activating mutation eligibility includes G12X / G13 / Q61. 1L untreated metastatic — patient is recurrent post-adjuvant FOLFIRI, so line fit depends on whether adjuvant FOLFIRI counts as prior systemic exposure in this protocol.
outcome: Confirmed ORR (early signal at dose level 1)
median_dor_or_pfs: Not mature; >6 months follow-up at dose level 1
safety_summary: Manageable across four dose cohorts; details pending full publication. FDA orphan drug designation granted on the back of this signal.
notes: ASCO 2024 abstract; full publication pending. 5-of-6 confirmed PRs at dose level 1 is striking but small. RAMP 205 trial registry NCT05669482 corresponds to the trials.jsonl row; included here for the efficacy preview that would weight any avutometinib/defactinib-backbone discussion.

intervention_dose: palbociclib 125 mg PO daily, 3 weeks on / 1 week off
indication: Histology-agnostic advanced solid tumors with CDK4 or CDK6 amplification (NCI-MATCH subprotocol Z1C)
population_detail: 38 eligible/treated patients with confirmed CDK4 or CDK6 amplification (≥7 copies). 25 patients in the primary analysis cohort. Pancreatic cancer was not the dominant histology; the read-out is for the CDK4/6 amplification call, not CDKN2A loss.
safety_summary: Standard palbociclib safety; cytopenias (notably neutropenia) drive grade 3+ events.

toxicities.notes: Class-defining AE for CDK4/6 inhibitors; specific Z1C rates not pulled from the abstract.

notes: Negative basket readout for palbociclib in CDK4/6-amplified tumors (ORR 4%). This is the closest published precedent for off-label palbociclib in a CDKN2A-loss / CCND3 case — the message it sends is that monotherapy CDK4/6 inhibition does not deliver in unselected biomarker-positive solid tumors. CDKN2A-loss enrichment (the patient's actual feature) was not the gating biomarker here; CAPTUR Group 8 and NCI-MATCH Z1F are the more relevant arms but those readouts are not yet published.

intervention_dose: pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks, up to 2 years
indication: MSI-H / dMMR previously treated noncolorectal advanced cancer (KEYNOTE-158)
population_detail: 233 enrolled across 27 tumor types; pancreatic n=22; MSI-H / dMMR required. The patient is MSS — biomarker-excluded from this indication. Logged to harden the MSS-PDAC ICI foreclosure call.
median_dor_or_pfs: Pancreatic subgroup: mDoR 13.4 mo; mPFS 2.0 mo; mOS 4.0 mo. Overall study mOS 23.5 mo, ORR 33.8%.
safety_summary: Grade 3+ treatment-related AEs in 14.6% of the 233-patient cohort; 5.2% discontinued for immune-mediated events.
notes: The PDAC ORR (18%) is real only for MSI-H disease, which the patient does not have. PDAC subgroup mPFS 2.0 / mOS 4.0 in the responder-enriched MSI-H cohort gives a ceiling for what monotherapy ICI delivers even when biomarker-positive. The patient is MSS / TMB 4.1 — the door is closed.

intervention_dose: durvalumab 1500 mg + tremelimumab 75 mg + gem/nab per protocol
population_detail: 180 randomized to chemo + dual ICI vs chemo alone; unselected for biomarker. The patient is recurrent rather than 1L untreated, but the negative readout is decision-relevant for any ICI-combination discussion.
median_dor_or_pfs: OS not improved (p=0.72); arm-level medians not separated cleanly in primary abstract.
safety_summary: Limited incremental toxicity beyond lymphocyte changes (p=0.02 for lymphocyte elevation); no fatal immune-related events reported.

toxicities.notes: Only AE term reaching significance vs control.

notes: Negative RCT for dual ICI added to chemo in unselected metastatic PDAC. The subgroup signal in KRAS-wildtype patients is hypothesis-generating only. For an MSS / sub-10-TMB G12R patient, this is the load-bearing negative evidence for adding biomarker-agnostic ICI to chemo.

exclusion_reason: Standard-of-care chemotherapy for the indication whose mechanism does not target the patient's targetable features (KRAS G12R, CDKN2A loss, CCND3, MSS, TMB 4.1). Out-of-scope per Libby's feature-targeting rule. Included as a one-line audit-trail entry so the reviewer can see it was reviewed and decided not to compile.
notes: OS 11.1 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.57 for FOLFIRINOX vs gemcitabine — landmark 1L PDAC benchmark. The treating team handles SoC chemo independent of Libby; logging only as a comparator-context anchor for the board's framing of what 'standard alternatives deliver'.

exclusion_reason: Standard-of-care chemotherapy that does not target the patient's molecular features. Out-of-scope per Libby's feature-targeting rule. Logged as the comparator context for the gem/nab combination arms in RAMP-205 and RMC-GI-102.
notes: OS 8.5 vs 6.7 mo, HR 0.72 — the second 1L PDAC standard. Same scoping rationale as the FOLFIRINOX row.

indication: Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, second-line after gemcitabine-based therapy
exclusion_reason: Standard-of-care 2L chemotherapy that does not target the patient's molecular features. Out-of-scope per Libby's feature-targeting rule. The patient already received FOLFIRI adjuvant, so prior irinotecan further limits the second-line nal-IRI option.
notes: OS 6.1 vs 4.2 mo with nal-IRI+5FU vs 5FU, HR 0.67 — the comparator that the recurrent-PDAC SoC discussion would otherwise default to. Same scoping rationale as the other SoC chemo rows.

exclusion_reason: Standard-of-care 1L chemotherapy that does not target the patient's molecular features. Out-of-scope per Libby's feature-targeting rule.
notes: OS 11.1 vs 9.2 mo (HR 0.83, p=0.036) — new 1L reference regimen for mPDAC. The patient has had FOLFIRI adjuvant (irinotecan-exposed) but is oxaliplatin-naive, which keeps this regimen on the SoC table at the treating team's discretion.
